args: Implement docs/plans/bengaluru-pilot-launch-plan.md using only the tools listed in its Section 2: open one draft PR with the preview URL at the top; Part 1 gitleaks in CI, repository files, citation files and issue forms; Part 2 rebuild the map with existing data (layers in the stated order, place search from a build-time place index, place card with rules for the zone and page links, sheet overlay with opacity, shareable address, generated accuracy and coverage lines, browse-by-ward page, Map in the main navigation, budgets and Lighthouse thresholds); Part 3 llms.txt, llms-full.txt, Markdown pages, JSON API with OpenAPI 3.1, schema.org Legislation markup, data package, Atom feed and "Use with AI" page; Part 4 the verification flow (task sets, verify page with browser-side export, import command, two Match verdicts for person-verified, verifier credits); Part 5 pilot, How we check, Join, Press pages, Report a problem everywhere and "current as of" dates, with every number generated from data; Part 6 partner documents in docs/partners/; Part 7 accessibility, social images, sitemap, robots, 404 and analytics; commit and push after each part, keep docs/progress.md current and the PR's "Owner actions", "Decisions made" and "Known gaps" sections up to date; never invent or rewrite legal text.
